notes.title: 🩸Patch 1.2.1 is Now Live!🩸
notes.notes:
🩸 VIOLET - Patch 1.2.1 is Now Live! 🩸

Hey Survivors! 🧟‍♀️🧠
It’s been a while since the last update, but we’ve always been listening behind the scenes! 👀📩
Today, a new issue was reported… and guess what? It’s already fixed! ✅

Here’s what’s new in version 1.2.1:

🌍 Russian Language Fix: Fixed some issues with the Russian text in Hisoka Ayumi's puzzle that prevented proper progression. 🇷🇺💬
🧽 General Polish: Minor improvements and visual tweaks in certain areas. Smoother, cleaner, better! ✨
🚀 Improved Performance: Overall performance has been slightly improved across the board. Let it flow! 💨


🔧 Huge thanks to everyone still playing, reporting bugs, and supporting the project!
Your support keeps this world alive… or something like that. 💀🖤

Until the next update, and remember...
🌕 Violet only stays quiet... when it’s waiting for you to let your guard down. 👁️‍🗨️💜

notes.title: SEXY HALLOWEEN OUTFIT UPDATE 1.2 IS OUT!
notes.notes:
Hello, Survivors! 👻 

We are thrilled to announce the release of version 1.2, bringing a special update to celebrate Halloween! 🎃🧙‍♀️

 What’s New: 

Halloween Special Outfit for Catherine Markwell – Get ready to face the horrors of Violet in style with Catherine’s new witch outfit, inspired by the tale of the mysterious Ankhesenpaaten! (Available below) The outfit will be unlockable once you’ve completed the game. For those who have already finished the story, your accumulated points can be used to unlock this new outfit right away.

 Unlockables: 

Violet now has a total of 26 unlockable outfits, including this new Halloween-themed addition. And the best part? None of the outfits cost extra! Just play, explore, and unlock with the points you earn throughout your journey.

 Halloween Tale - The Enchanted Witch’s Night 

On the darkest night of the year, as dry leaves danced in the wind 🍂 and the full moon 🌕 illuminated the skies over Siren's Well, Catherine Markwell walked through the ancient forest 🌲, heading toward a mysterious, abandoned castle. Dressed in her new witch’s costume—a black, form-fitting dress with golden details and a pointed hat that exuded power—Catherine felt the cold air against her skin ❄️, the light, provocative fabric caressing her body with every step.

She had heard rumors that the castle held forgotten secrets—prohibited spells and ancient charms left behind by a witch who had vanished centuries ago. Catherine knew it was risky, but her curiosity drove her. With her mission set in mind, she couldn't resist the temptation to discover more.

The castle door creaked open, revealing a grand hall filled with dancing shadows and candles 🕯️ spread across the corners. In the center, an ancient table was covered in mysterious symbols, with a grimoire lying open, its pages turning on their own. As she approached, the candles flickered, and an invisible presence seemed to follow her every move.

Suddenly, a whispering voice echoed through the halls. "You've come for my power, haven't you, Catherine?"

She spun around quickly, her heart racing 💓. Standing before her was the ethereal form of a woman dressed in a similar outfit—a witch from the past. Her eyes glowed like embers 🔥, and a mysterious smile curved her lips.

"My power is tempting," Catherine replied with a challenging tone. "But what do you want in return?"

The witch smiled even more, her eyes sweeping over Catherine from head to toe. "Just one dance, my dear. A dance with the shadows, and I will give you more than you can imagine."

Catherine hesitated for a moment, but something in the atmosphere pulled her in. Haunting music 🎶 filled the air, and the shadows began to sway to the rhythm. With a mischievous smile 😏, Catherine accepted the invitation. Her hands moved gracefully, and she let herself be taken by the dance, her body’s movements teasing the shadows around her as if they were alive.

The shadows wrapped around her like a cloak 🖤, tracing the silhouette of her body, playing with the contours of her figure. It was a seductive dance, full of mystery and power, where every gesture seemed to echo ancient magic. The witch's gaze intensified, and the candles burned brighter 🔥.

When the dance finally ended, the witch leaned closer, satisfied. "You have pleased me, Catherine. The power is now yours. But remember, magic always comes at a price."

With those words, the witch vanished, leaving behind only the grimoire, now inscribed with new pages in Catherine’s own hand ✍️. She smiled, feeling the energy flowing through her ✨. On that Halloween night 🎃, she had not only gained new power but also become part of a dark and seductive legacy, ready to be explored.

As she left the castle, the wind whispered a name that made her pause for a moment, her eyes widening slightly. The name was Ankhesenpaaten, the forgotten witch, whose power now resided within her.

We thank you for all the support and continuous feedback from our community. Enjoy Halloween in style, and don’t forget to share your moments with Catherine’s new outfit!

Get ready for more surprises and scares as we continue expanding the world of Violet! 🎮🖤

notes.title: SEXY OUTFITS UPDATE 1.1 IS OUT!
notes.notes:
New Unlockable Outfits in Violet! 🎉

Hello survivors!

We have some exciting news to share with you! Starting today, Violet receives a special update adding 4 new unlockable outfits, one for each character! This brings the total to 25 unlockable outfits in the game, all completely free! 🎁

How to unlock:
- Simply play and finish the game once.
- No need to achieve a specific ending. Any ending you reach will let you unlock the new outfits! 🎮

This is our way of saying thank you to all of you for playing and supporting Violet. We want you to have fun exploring these new styles and continue enjoying the game.

We hope you love this update, and we're excited to hear your feedback. Stay tuned for more news and future updates. 🌟

Thank you for being part of our community!

notes.title: PATCH NOTES 1.0.22
notes.notes:
New Features  🎮✨
- Y-Axis Inversion: It is now possible to invert the Y-axis for both mouse and gamepad. This option can be found in the game settings. 🔄🖱️🎮

We thank all players for their continuous feedback and support. 🙌💖 We will continue to work on improving the gaming experience! 🚀🎉

notes.title: PATCH NOTES 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors,

Fixes & Polishment:
- 🛠️ Added More Hints On Screen: Improved guidance for using the gamepad and keyboard/mouse to enhance the user experience.
- 🐛 Fixed Yumi Spawning Issue: Resolved the problem where Yumi would sometimes spawn in unusual or inaccessible places.
- ⚔️ Improved 1st Boss Fight: Enhanced the mechanics and overall experience of the first boss encounter for a smoother and more engaging challenge.

1st Boss Fight Changes:
- 🌐 Suitcase Riddle Adjustment: Due to localization challenges, the suitcase riddle in the 1st boss area has been removed. Instead, reward items can now be found inside some additional vases scattered around the area, adding an extra layer of difficulty to the game.

Thank you for your feedback!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.15
notes.notes:
Hotfix 1.0.15

Bug Fixes:

- 🛠️ Resolved Localization Issues: Fixed Japanese language translations for the Modisk Riddle in the Castle. Players can now enjoy a seamless experience without encountering language discrepancies.

- 🚀 Improved Main Menu Stability: Optimizations have been implemented to prevent crashes that occurred during startup on certain computer configurations.

notes.title: PATCH NOTES 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors, 

New Features
- Mouse Icon in Closet/D-Pad Navigation:
  - 🖱️ Added a mouse icon in the closet and on the D-Pad to indicate the presence of more skins. This will help players easily navigate and discover all available skins.

Improvements
- Enhanced Ghosts Behavior:
  - 👻 Improved the ghosts to deal damage earlier in their encounter. This adjustment is aimed at increasing the challenge and intensity of ghost interactions.

Bug Fixes
- Endings Guide Display Issue:
  - 📜 Fixed an issue where the endings guide was not showing properly after completing the game and reopening it. Players can now view the endings guide correctly after finishing the game.

We appreciate your continued support and feedback. Enjoy the updated version of the game! 🚀
